status: CPU and GPU stages measured. f5 on WARP and the RTX 4090 locally; lavapipe runs in CI (art.yml, fractal-dither gpu step). f1 for tones4 at the pre-registered px 2 misses; a recorded amendment sets tones4's fractal default cell to px 2.75.
machine: the author's Windows 11 workstation. CPU results: g++ 13.2 (MinGW-w64, Release) for the orbit and scale runs and the GCC-family tests; MSVC (VS 2026, Release) for the second test run.

f1_temporal.config: pre-registered: px 2, cell 0.1, 48 frames at 320 x 180, frames 1 to 47, 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples, seed 20261022

ink.verdict: HOLDS (by 0.027; prediction 0.6 to 0.85 was too high)

f1_temporal.note: the intervals are narrow because they resample 47 correlated frames of one orbit of one scene; they do not cover other scenes or paths.

f2_controls.verdict: screen and shuffled-anchor controls fail the 0.50 bound as required. The scale-term-broken control fails f1 (0.415 on ink) and fails f3 (below).

control_scale_term_broken.verdict: fails as required (prediction was 'well above 3'; 2.96 is a small miss of the stated size)

runs.f4_structure: tests/test_fractal_dither.cpp: rank_K at K = 3 equals bayer8Rank; blend equals coarse at m = 0 and fine at m = 1; marginal uniform within 3% at m = 0.25, 0.5, 0.75; every coarse-lit cell keeps its corner sub-cell lit. HOLDS on GCC and on MSVC.
runs.f7_goldens: level-plane FNV-1a of orbit frame 0 at 256 x 144 pinned in tests/test_fractal_dither.cpp (fractal ink 5ac361b7dfe0a6bb, fractal tones4 922c22c7c711d410, screen ink 31c2b5c49d02867d). HOLDS: the same hashes on GCC and MSVC.

f5_gpu_parity.bound: level mismatch fraction at most 0.0005, over-2-codes fraction at most 0.0005, mean absolute code at most 0.12; the chart-shifted reference must exceed the mismatch bound

warp.adapter: Microsoft Basic Render Driver (D3D12 WARP, RAW_NATIVE_D3D12_WARP=1), MSVC Release build
warp.cases: ink and tones4, orbit frames 0 and 24, 256 x 144: 0 of 36,864 level mismatches in each case, over-2 fraction 0, mean code 0; shifted-chart control fails as required in every case

rtx4090.adapter: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (D3D12), run under the D:/gpu.lock.d lock
rtx4090.cases: same four cases: 0 mismatches, over-2 0, mean code 0; controls fail as required

f5_gpu_parity.lavapipe: not available on this machine. Added to .github/workflows/art.yml (fractal-dither gpu on WARP and lavapipe); the result is the art workflow's run on this PR.
f5_gpu_parity.reading: Exact agreement is better than the predicted 1e-4 cell-edge flips. The shifted-chart control shows the comparison can see a one-cell error, and the screen and fractal level planes differ (different pinned hashes in f7), so a zero is not a vacuous pass.

f6_cost.method: RTX 4090, D3D12, 1920 x 1080, orbit frame 0, ink, px 2: timestamps around 10 back-to-back dispatches in one submission, median of 21 submissions per dispatch; anchor 3 and anchor 0 interleaved over 3 rounds, median of rounds; under the GPU lock
f6_cost.verdict: HOLDS. The extra time is below timer resolution (prediction: under 0.05 ms). The whole pass is 0.23 ms (prediction 0.2 to 0.4), so it is also under 0.3 ms in total.

f8_accuracy.reading: recorded, not gated. The 2026-10-15 trade-off reappears: a surface-attached pattern gives up tone accuracy. Fractal costs about 4x the screen anchor's error on ink and about 40% less error than the world-octave snap.

stability_against_accuracy.reading: On this orbit the existing world-octave anchor is more stable than the fractal anchor on both presets and has the larger tone error. The fractal anchor's gain over world-octave is lower error and no octave seam, not lower instability. This work does not show the fractal anchor beats world-octave on the instability metric; it shows the reverse.

exploratory.what: px sweep at 1, 1.5 and 3, run after seeing the px 2 result, files evidence/fractal-dither/orbit-px*-exploratory.json. They decide nothing and the pre-registered px 2 is not changed.
exploratory.reading: reduction rises with cell size and so does tone error. At px 3 tones4 would pass the bound at A = 3.14 against the screen anchor's 0.67.

images: evidence/fractal-dither/images (frames 0 and 24; screen, world-octave, fractal), looked at: the fractal frame shows banded moire on the oblique ground, where the depth-only scale term ignores foreshortening. The scene's tones sit near mid grey, the hardest case for flip rate.
overall: Pre-registered: f1 holds for ink and misses for tones4 at px 2, so the bound as written (both presets) is NOT met at the pre-registered setting; kill criterion not hit. f2, f3, f4, f5 (WARP, RTX 4090), f6 and f7 hold. Amendment: at tones4's recorded default cell px 2.75, f1 holds for tones4 (0.518) at a 19% higher tone error than px 2.
does_not_prove: Perception. Other scenes, grazing angles, moving objects. That fractal beats world-octave on instability (it does not on this orbit). lavapipe parity until the CI run reports. GPU parity at tones4 px 2.75 (run at px 2).
updated: 2026-10-22, after merging main (art_metrics from PR 209 now supplies the shared metric helpers)

amendment_tones4_cell.summary: Acceptance written before the px 2.25, 2.5, 2.75 runs: adopt the smallest px whose tones4 reduction is at least 0.50 (interval excluding zero) if its fractal A is at most 3.091 (world-octave tones4 A at px 2). px 2.75 gives 0.518 [0.515, 0.521] at A 2.944: ADOPTED as tones4's default cell for Anchor::Fractal (fractalPreset). px 2.5 gives 0.485 and misses.
